full_prompt_en: A square monochrome architectural photomontage shows a weathered, many-sided house fused with a thick bare tree on an empty plain beneath storm clouds. The ground is a pale expanse of rough dirt and scattered stones, stretching toward a low, thin horizon. Across the upper half, layered gray clouds gather heavily, with a brighter opening behind the central roofline. On the left of the structure, the tree's trunk twists upward and spreads a web of leafless branches against the sky. The house occupies the center-right, its small tower, steep roofs, projecting porch, and stacked windows looking assembled from several older buildings. Dark clapboard, masonry-like surfaces, and deep openings sit next to one another with deliberately uneasy joins. Beneath the main rooms, roots and thick irregular supports merge into a raised platform, making the architecture appear to grow from the tree while hovering above the exposed ground. At the lower left, a few low blocks and abandoned fragments punctuate the barren foreground. Farther back, small distant structures and faint vertical elements emphasize the isolation and scale of the central construction. Sharp, fine architectural detail contrasts with the softer sky and faint horizon. Directional light filters through the cloud opening from behind and above, touching the roof edges and the bare ground while deep recesses stay nearly black. The grayscale range extends from silvery highlights to charcoal shadows, and the image has the tonal grain and impossible coherence of a carefully assembled photograph. The overall composition sets one intricate, uncanny vertical mass against a wide, quiet plain and a turbulent sky.
full_prompt_zh: 这幅方形黑白建筑拼贴影像描绘一栋风化的多面房屋与粗壮枯树融合，立在暴风云下的空旷平原上。地面是一片浅色粗土和零散石块，向低而细的地平线延伸。上半部层层灰云沉重聚集，中央屋顶后方留有较亮的开口。建筑左侧，树干扭曲向上，光秃树枝在天空前织成枝网。房屋占据中央偏右，其小塔、陡屋顶、凸出的门廊与层叠窗户仿佛由几栋老建筑拼合而成。深色木板墙、类似石砌的表面和幽暗开口相邻，接合处有意显得不安稳。主要房间下方，树根和粗厚不规则支撑融入抬高的平台，使建筑像从树中长出，又悬在裸露地面之上。左下方几块低矮石块和废弃碎片点断荒凉前景。更远处的小建筑和隐约竖向构件强调中央结构的孤立与尺度。清晰精细的建筑细节与较柔和的天空、淡远地平线形成反差。定向光从背后上方的云层开口滤入，擦亮屋顶边缘与裸地，深凹处则近乎全黑。灰阶从银亮高光延伸到炭黑阴影，影像带有精心组接照片的色调颗粒和不可能的连贯性。整体构图把一团繁复诡异的竖向体量置于宽广寂静的平原与动荡天空之间。
style_prompt_en: The image has a monochrome photographic collage finish, in which finely resolved fragments are assembled into a single physically improbable but tonally coherent scene. Silver gray, weathered midtones, and deep charcoal create an expansive tonal range without color accents. Hard, precise edges describe the focal construction, while distant detail and cloud boundaries soften into grain and atmosphere. Repeated small rectilinear marks accumulate into dense vertical masses, set against broad stretches of nearly empty ground and sky. Directional light breaks through a heavy overcast field, catching upper edges and leaving recesses in deep shadow. Surface wear, faint photographic grain, and uneven tonal patches make the composite tactile rather than polished. The eye moves from intricate clustered detail to spare horizontal space and back into turbulent overhead forms. The overall effect is uncanny, austere, and quietly monumental.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有黑白摄影拼贴的完成质感，精细解析的片段被组接成一个物理上奇异、色调上却连贯的场景。银灰、风化的中间调和深炭色构成宽广灰阶，没有彩色强调。坚硬精确的边缘勾勒焦点结构，远处细节与云层边界则柔化为颗粒和空气感。反复出现的细小直线形标记积成密集竖向体量，与大片近乎空白的地面和天空对置。定向光穿过沉重阴云，照亮上缘，把凹处留在深影中。表面磨损、轻微摄影颗粒和不均匀色调斑块使拼合画面具有触感，而非过度光洁。目光从繁复聚集的细节移向稀疏的水平空间，再回到头顶动荡的形态。整体效果诡异、冷峻而静静地具有纪念碑感。
theme_en: An improbable house fused with a bare tree beneath storm clouds
theme_zh: 暴风云下与枯树融合的奇异房屋
name: Jim Kazanjian
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
